snippet.title: Goodbye, GTA 5...
snippet.description:
On November 19th GTA 6 finally comes out, and 13 years of GTA 5 come to an end. This is everything that happened in the GTA 5 era, year by year, from the first trailer to the night before GTA 6.
The secret Bigfoot ritual players dug out of the code, the fan mod Take-Two sent private investigators after and then bought, the 2022 hack, the record roleplay nights, and what happens to GTA 5 once GTA 6 is out.

One last night drive with Non-Stop-Pop FM before we all head to Vice City in GTA 6.

Turn up the radio, take the long way home, and remember all the moments we shared. ❤️

snippet.title: GTA 5's Final Message Before GTA 6 🥹
snippet.description:
13 years of Los Santos. One last goodbye. 🥹

Before we all head to Vice City, DJ Cara has one last message, and an invite:
📍 Nov 18 · Los Santos International Airport · 10 PM CT
🚗 Bring your favourite car and your friends. No racing, no fighting, just one last ride.

Which GTA 5 memory will you never forget? 👇

Credits: fan-made broadcast. Audio via shasi_verse (Instagram) and DJ BrG Music ("GTA V – Last Ride" community event). Gameplay footage © Rockstar Games. Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.

snippet.description:
POV: DJ CARA’S EMOTIONAL MESSAGE BEFORE GTA 6 🥹💔

BRO, THIS HITS DIFFERENT… 😭❤️

Just driving through Los Santos, listening to DJ Cara on the radio… 🚗🌆

AND SUDDENLY, EVERYTHING FEELS DIFFERENT. 🥹

AFTER 13 YEARS OF GTA 5…

ALL THOSE MEMORIES…

ALL THOSE UNFORGETTABLE MOMENTS…

ALL THOSE HOURS SPENT IN LOS SANTOS… ❤️

AND NOW GTA 6 IS ALMOST HERE! 🌴🎮

DJ CARA’S MESSAGE MAKES THIS MOMENT EVEN MORE EMOTIONAL. 💔

IT REALLY FEELS LIKE THE END OF AN ERA. 😭

LOS SANTOS WILL ALWAYS HAVE A SPECIAL PLACE IN OUR HEARTS! 🥹❤️

THANK YOU FOR THE MEMORIES, GTA 5! 🫶

AND HELLO, LEONIDA! 🌴🔥

🎮 Game: Grand Theft Auto V (GTA 5)
📻 Radio: DJ Cara
🌴 Theme: Goodbye Los Santos, Hello GTA 6
🎬 Creator: iGor
